card.name: Other signs and symptoms after symptom lists
card.fires_on: The word "signs" in "Other signs and symptoms also may develop", after a list of withdrawal symptoms. Also "other" in "headache and other serious symptoms".

modes.label: Other signs after symptom list
modes.description: "signs" following "Other" at the end of a list of withdrawal symptoms.
modes.example: chills, myalgia, and mydriasis. Other<< signs>> and symptoms also may develop, including irrit

modes.label: Other serious symptoms
modes.description: "other" after a named symptom, leading into more symptoms of a reaction.
modes.example: may cause a reaction characterized by headache and<< other>> serious symptoms due to a rise in blood

card.writes: Suppresses words like dream, nightmares and headaches, so the next word is not a symptom already named.
card.plain: It fires on the word that introduces further symptoms after a list of symptoms has already been given.
